title: 세라믹 커패시터로 바꾼 뒤 벅 출력 링잉
cause: output capacitor ESR changed, compensation not recalculated, low phase margin
fix: recalculate compensation for ceramic output capacitor, increase Cout

title: 긴 배선의 I2C 버스에서 간헐적 NACK
cause: pull-up resistor too large for bus capacitance, slow rise time
fix: lower pull-up resistor within the allowed range, shorten bus

title: 입력 전압 차가 큰 LDO 과열
cause: large VIN-VOUT difference, dissipation too high for package theta_JA
fix: lower input voltage with a pre-regulator or use a switching converter
